messages:
jamie: Heads-up — scheduling an engine swap + quant-profile bump for `ai-engine` v2 -> v2.1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Plan: sequential slot swap across 6 slices, 5m soak per slice, warm KV cache after each swap. Owners: jamie (deploy), maria (smoke), alex (rollback). Please ack and call out any infra or model blockers.

maria: Acked. I'll run the smoke suite and watch latency/error-rate panels during each slice. Where are the smoke scripts? URL?

alex: I can own rollback. Rollback playbook (quick):
```
# rollback quick commands
redwoodctl rollout cancel --deployment ai-engine:v2.1 || true
redwoodctl promote --deployment ai-engine:v2
# flush edge caches if needed
infractl kv-cache flush --prefix ai-engine/kv
```
I'll be on standby during the window.

sam: LGTM from infra tests I ran earlier. I'll seed a canary cohort hitting the canary slice (~2% traffic) 30m before swap to validate output distribution. I have a small script to synth traffic and check token/time histograms: 
```
python tools/smoke/emit_load.py --model ai-engine:v2.1 --qps 5 --duration 600
```
I'll post results in this thread.

henry: Quick question — does v2.1 require a different kernel or CUDA stack? We had a node with CUDA mismatch in last rollout.

jamie: Good catch. v2.1 uses the same CUDA minor as v2 (11.8) but pulls a newer quant lib that depends on kernel 5.15+ for a specific intrinsics path. infra already confirmed nodes in the target pool are on 5.15. If you spot any 5.4 machines, mark them and we'll exclude the slice.

infra-bot: Slot reservation confirmed: maintenance-window 2026-03-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. Affected pools: slice-a..slice-f.

ops-bot: Reminder: set the rollback owner tag in the deployment doc and enable circuit-breaker at 10% error threshold for the first two slices.

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- run smoke script (tools/smoke/basic_smoke.sh)
- check per-route p95 latency and error-rate on `/v1/chat`
- verify KV cache warm hit-rate > 60% after warmers
- validate function-calling payloads (sample set)

sam: I pushed a tiny PR with the smoke script update: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/512 - need one quick review.

alex: If rollback is triggered, I'll perform staged rollback: cancel rollout -> promote previous -> run sanity (basic smoke) -> clear any partial caches. Expected downtime for rollback path: < 3 minutes for promotion, plus soak.

jamie: No other blockers called out. final ask: please post a short "ready" in this thread by EOD UTC. We'll start handoff 30m before window. Also, maria — can you add the exact dashboard links you'll watch?

maria: Ready. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/engine-latency, https://dash.redwood.ai/d/error-rate, and the token-cost heatmap. I'll post a short pre-swap screenshot.

sam: Ready. I'll run the canary load and report 10m into soak.

henry: I confirmed node kernel versions in target pool are 5.15+. No manual exclusions needed.

ops-bot: Noted. All owners on-call for this window: jamie, maria, alex, sam.

jamie: Thanks all — we'll run the checklist and start the swap at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. If anything changes I will update this thread.
